item.text: The app already has a session helper that checks `session.role === 'admin'`. I’ll use it from a server page, call `forbidden()` for non-admin sessions, and enable Next’s auth interruption support so the `forbidden.tsx` boundary is rendered with HTTP 403. I’m also making the page dynamic so an authorization decision can’t be cached.

item.text:
Implemented `/admin` with a server-side role check. Non-admin sessions call Next.js’s `forbidden()` boundary, which renders the custom 403 page in [app/forbidden.tsx](/workspace/app/forbidden.tsx). Enabled auth interruptions in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts) and made the admin page dynamic so authorization decisions aren’t cached.

The current mock session has the `user` role, so `/admin` will show the 403 page by default. A session with the `admin` role will see the dashboard in [app/admin/page.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx).

I didn’t run tests.
